To calculate how many gallons of gasoline Karla would have saved, we need to first calculate the difference in fuel efficiency between the hybrid car and the SUV. The hybrid car averages 48 miles per gallon, while the SUV averages 15 miles per gallon.

Difference in miles per gallon = Hybrid car's miles per gallon - SUV's miles per gallon
Difference in miles per gallon = 48 miles per gallon - 15 miles per gallon
Difference in miles per gallon = 33 miles per gallon

Now we can calculate the number of gallons saved by using the formula: gallons saved = total miles driven / difference in miles per gallon

gallons saved = 12,000 miles / 33 miles per gallon
gallons saved = 363.6363...

So, Karla would have saved approximately 363.64 gallons of gasoline last year by driving a fuel-efficient hybrid car rather than an SUV.
